name: Diani Beach
blurb: Conversation about Diani Beach is up 201% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Good value compared with last year
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Second time here and it still feels underrated.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
The food alone would be worth the trip.
